standard: IEEE 1800-2023 11.4.14: a stream assigned to a fixed-size target wider than the stream is filled with zero bits on the right, and a dynamically sized target is resized to the smallest number of elements that hold the stream; 11.4.14.1: a queue or dynamic array stream expression contributes all its elements, an empty one none; 11.4.14.4 and 6.24.3: an unpack into a list with an unbounded dynamically sized item is greedy, the first such item takes the bits left after the fixed-size items.
method: The shared cases run unchanged in verify-sv-verilator, verify-sv-icarus and verify-sv-xezim; each reduced source below runs without the adapters (verilator --binary, iverilog -g2012 -s Top, xezim -s Top). Celox's output is the one the passing shared assertions require.
